page_data.en:
S. B. REGIS
No. S. D. 7865
Jul Date 1941. 4/7 11

Fight Amongst Casual Wharf Coolies on French Bund

At about 8 a.m. July 1, a fight suddenly occurred amongst some 100 casual coolies on the Butterfield & Swire Wharf on Rue Chateau d'Eau, French Bund. Some 10 coolies were injured, and 42 were arrested by the French Police but released shortly afterwards.

Enquiries show that the fight broke out when some 50 casual coolies, all armed with iron bars etc./and led by one Chow Zai Sung (周瑞生), arrived at the Wharf and tried to interfere with the other casual coolies. Chow Zai Sung, it is learned, was formerly the foreman of the casual coolies but was dismissed by the Butterfield & Swire, Ltd. when he joined the Wharf Coolies Labour Union some time in Autumn last year. He was replaced by one Siao Shao Shing (小绍兴). As a result, Chow led his sympathizers to the Wharf on July 1 when they attacked the other casual coolies employed there. It is reported that Chow Zai Sung sustained serious injuries during the fight and the Shanghai Branch of the Social Movement Direction Committee was behind the conflict.

S. B. REGIS
编号 S. D. 7865
日期 1941年7月4日 11时

法租界外滩太古码头临时苦力斗殴事件

7月1日上午8时许，法租界外滩薛华立路（Rue Chateau d'Eau）太古洋行（Butterfield & Swire）码头约100名临时苦力中突然发生斗殴。约10名苦力受伤，42人被法国警察逮捕，但随后不久即获释。

经查，斗殴起因是约50名手持铁棍等物的临时苦力抵达码头，试图干扰其他临时苦力工作，这群人由周瑞生（Chow Zai Sung）带领。据悉，周瑞生原为临时苦力工头，但因去年秋季加入码头苦力工会而被太古洋行有限公司解雇。其职位由小绍兴（Siao Shao Shing）接替。因此，周瑞生于7月1日带领支持者前往码头，袭击受雇于此的其他临时苦力。据报道，周瑞生在斗殴中受重伤，且社会运动指导委员会上海分会是此次冲突的背后推手。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No: 7565
Date December 26, 1940.

Subject Butterfield & Swire - strike of coolies.

Made by D.I. Pan Lien Pin Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

Some 300 loading and unloading coolies
in the employ of the Butterfield & Swire, 21
French Bund, declared a "tai-kung" strike at
6 a.m. December 23, in order to enforce a demand
for an increase in wages. They resumed work
at 11 a.m. the same day when the management
granted them an increase from $2.00 to $3.20
each per day and from $2.30 to $3.50 each per
night.

Some 1,000 casual coolies working for the
company also demanded better treatment. Tsiu Zen
Pao (朱寿葆), a representative of the coolies,
and Voong Ts Shan (馮志山), a representative of
the General Labour Union in Nantao, conducted
negotiations with the management on behalf of
the casual coolies, with the result that the
management agreed to increase their wages to
$3.00 each per day and $3.30 each per night, being
20 cents less than the wages for regular coolies.

Pan Lien Pin
D. I.

A.C. (Special Branch)

（批：Filed on instructions
C.A. to S.B. Rogg.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科第一股
报告
档案号：7565
日期 1940年12月26日。

主题 太古洋行 - 苦力罢工。

撰写人 巡官 Pan Lien Pin 转呈人 巡官 Crawford

受雇于法租界外滩21号太古洋行的约300名装卸苦力，于12月23日上午6时宣布“怠工”罢工，以强制要求增加工资。当管理层同意将每人日薪从2.00元增至3.20元，夜班薪金从2.30元增至3.50元后，他们于当日上午11时复工。

为该公事工作的约1,000名临时苦力也要求改善待遇。苦力代表朱寿葆（Tsiu Zen Pao）和南市总工会代表馮志山（Voong Ts Shan）代表临时苦力与管理层进行谈判，结果是管理层同意将他们的工资提高到每人日薪3.00元，夜班3.30元，比正式苦力的工资少20分。

Pan Lien Pin
巡官

助理处长（特务科）

（批：按指示归档
C.A. 致 S.B. Rogg.
1941年1月7日 收）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. D. 756-C
S.1, Special Branch Attached.
REPORT
Date October 20, 1936.

Subject S.S. "Hsin Peking" - unrest among cabinboys subsides
(further to report dated October 19, 1936)

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

The unrest which arose recently among the 161
cabin-boys employed on board the s.s. "Hsin Peking" of the
China Navigation Company against a reduction of their number
subsided on October 19, when the 65 boys to be employed were
chosen by lot in the Cabin-boys' Guild, Yoong Foh Li, North
Wong E Ma Loong, City, while the remaining 96 were each paid
a retiring gratuity of $100.00 by the compradores.

Apart from this sum, each employed cabin boy will
contribute $90.00 for the unemployed. This contribution
was agreed upon by the boys prior to the casting of lots.

Copy sent to French Police.
D.S.I.

D.C. (Special Branch).

（印：20 OCT. 1936）

附：特务科第一股。
报告
日期 1936年10月20日。

主题 “新北京”轮（S.S. "Hsin Peking"）- 侍役骚乱平息
（继1936年10月19日报告之后）

撰写人 副巡官 Kao Yen-ken 转呈人 **〔此处转录不清〕**

英商中国轮船公司（China Navigation Company）“新北京”轮上161名侍役因反对裁员而引发的近期骚乱，已于10月19日平息。当时在位于市中心黄陂北路（North Wong E Ma Loong）永福里（Yoong Foh Li）的侍役公会通过抽签选出了留用的65人，其余96人则由买办每人支付100.00元作为遣散费。

除这笔款项外，每名被录用的侍役将出资90.00元用于资助失业者。这一出资方案是侍役们在抽签前达成一致的。

副本送交法国警察。
副巡官。

副处长（特务科）。

（印：1936年10月20日）

Date October 19, 1936.

Subject (in full) S.S. "Hsin Peking" - teaboys appeal to Ningpo Fellow Country-
men's Association.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

Two Chinese representing the teaboys employed on board
the s.s. "Hsin Peking" of the China Navigation Company called
at the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association, 480 Yu Ya Ching
Road, at 3 p.m. October 18, with the object of requesting Yu Ya
Ching to negotiate with the Chief Steward of the steamer for
the cancellation of his decision to reduce the number of boys.
They were received by a section chief of the Association who
promised to refer their request to Mr. Yu Ya Ching.

主题（全称） “新北京”轮（S.S. "Hsin Peking"）- 茶房向宁波同乡会求助。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. REGIST.
D. 7565
S.I, Special Branch XXX
REPORT
Date October 16, 1936.

Subject China Navigation Company - s.s. "Hsin Peking" - Reduction
in number of cabin-boys.

Made by U.S.I. Lao Yen-ken Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

In compliance with an instruction from the Agents
of the China Navigation Company, Messrs Butterfield & Swire,
21 Quai de France, the number of cabin boys on the s.s.
"Hsin Peking" are to be reduced from one hundred to sixty-five.
A retiring gratuity of $83 to each of the discharged
cabin-boys has been promised by the Compradore of the steamer,
but the boys are demanding that this sum be increased to $100.
These cabin-boys have opened an office at Room 308, Yah Chow
(亞州) Hotel, 135 Avenue Edward VII, French Concession.
The official number of cabin-boys employed on
the s.s. "Hsin Peking" is 100, but there are actually 161
cabin-boys on board this vessel.

Copy sent to Branch Police
N.B.
U. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH / 17 OCT. 1936 / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

特务科第一股 XXX
报告
日期 1936年10月16日。

主题 英商中国轮船公司 - “新北京”轮（s.s. "Hsin Peking"）- 削减侍役人数。

撰写人 高级巡官 Lao Yen-ken 转呈人 **〔此处转录不清〕**

遵照英商中国轮船公司代理人太古洋行（Messrs Butterfield & Swire，地址：法租界外滩21号）的指示，“新北京”轮上的侍役人数将从一百人减至六十五人。该轮买办已承诺向每位被解雇的侍役支付83元遣散费，但侍役们要求将此金额增加至100元。这些侍役已在法租界爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）135号亚洲酒店（Yah Chow Hotel）308室开设办事处。
“新北京”轮官方雇佣的侍役人数为100人，但该船实际有161名侍役。

副本送交分局警察
备注。
高级巡官。

副处长（特务科）。

（印：特务科 / 1936年10月17日 / 上海公共租界工部局警务处）
